theorems.name: Submission.anyrad_gc_graph_lintegral_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (Ω : Set (Rn n)), MeasurableSet Ω → ContinuousOn u Ω → ∀ ν : Measure (Amb n ℓ), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (q '' graphOver u Ω) ≤ ν → (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Ω → MeasurableSet (q '' graphOver u A)) ∧ (∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ Ω → ∀ g : Amb n ℓ → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g → ∫⁻ x in A, g (q (graphPoint x (u x))) ≤ ∫⁻ y in q '' graphOver u A, g y ∂ν) ∧ ∀ P : Amb n ℓ → Prop, (∀ᵐ y ∂ν, P y) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(volume.restrict Ω), P (q (graphPoint x (u x)))
